featured_reviews.name: Roland Rebeiro
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to formally express my deep dissatisfaction with the experience at Dream Arena during a christening celebration we recently attended as guests.

Unfortunately, the event was marred by several issues. The air conditioning was not functioning properly despite the intense summer heat, with the temperature set at 31°C. Instead of resolving the problem, a few ineffective fans were provided, which guests had to manage themselves, causing significant discomfort.

Additionally, the service was extremely poor. Guests had arrived at 11:00 AM, but starters were served only around 2:00 PM. Even then, the portions were minimal and insufficient. The quality of the food was also below expectations and appeared stale.

What was most disappointing was the attitude of the staff, who were rude, unhelpful, and insensitive to the needs of guests on such an important family occasion.

This experience caused unnecessary stress and discomfort for everyone involved. I strongly urge the management to take this feedback seriously and improve both service quality and guest handling.

I hope appropriate action will be taken to ensure such incidents do not occur in the future.
